subject: Mid-cycle capacity increase and proration for Greystone Analytics
messages:

To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Capacity increase request (mid-cycle) — Greystone PO attached

Hi Neha,

We need to add 12 dedicated seats to our Redwood Dedicated pool effective July 5. Our procurement team approved an updated PO (attached) but because this is a mid-cycle change we need clarity on how you will invoice the partial month and handle VAT — we are an EU entity (Germany).

Key asks:
- Exact prorated charge for remainder of our June/July billing cycle
- Whether you will issue a separate proforma for the prorate vs. the regular monthly renewal
- VAT treatment: we can provide VAT ID if that enables reverse-charge.
- Preferred payment methods and whether we can remit to an escrow/held payment until paperwork is confirmed.

Attached: Greystone_PO_624.pdf (signed by procurement).

Please loop in billing/finance with a quick breakdown so procurement can issue payment on time.

Thanks,
Lara Müller
Head of Procurement
Greystone Analytics
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Greystone Procurement <procurement@greystone-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Capacity increase request (mid-cycle) — Greystone PO attached

Hi Lara — thanks for the PO and the heads up. Happy to confirm the approach and next steps. Below is what we recommend to avoid double-taxation and to keep the provisioning timeline tight.

Summary (proposal):
- Prorated charge calculation: charge for 12 seats for remainder of the current billing period (Jul 5 — Jul 31).
- Invoice flow: issue a proforma (held) for the prorate amount so procurement can remit immediately; we will mark it as "held pending VAT evidence". Once VAT ID/certificate is validated we will issue the final invoice and clear the hold. If reverse-charge applies we will not collect VAT; if not provided, VAT (19%) will be charged and remitted.
- Currency: we will invoice in EUR (your preference) to avoid FX friction.
- Payment: wire transfer or credit card via Stripe. If Greystone prefers funds held in an escrow-like hold, finance recommends using our Stripe invoice with "payment held" status until VAT docs are confirmed — we do not use third-party escrow.

Preliminary numbers (example) — please confirm price per seat is still €120/month as in the SOW: 
- Monthly for 12 seats: 12 x €120 = €1,440/month
- Proration window: Jul 5–Jul 31 = 27 days of a 31-day cycle => 27/31 of monthly charge = (27/31) * €1,440 = €1,254.84 (rounded to €1,254.84)
- If VAT required (19%): VAT = €238.42 -> gross = €1,493.26

I have CC'd Marissa (AM) to coordinate timing and Karthik (finance) for the final invoice. I will attach a proforma for your records.

Attached: RWI-GREY-PRORATE-0705.pdf (proforma, net amount).

Can you confirm: 1) VAT ID and company billing entity, 2) preferred payment method, and 3) whether July 5 provisioning is OK?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T10:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Capacity increase request — suggested invoicing and tax handling

Neha / Marissa — quick finance note and recommended wording for billing. I ran the numbers and set out options depending on VAT evidence.

Assumptions: unit price €120/seat/month, proration from Jul 5–Jul 31 (27/31).

Calculation steps (rounded):
- Net prorated amount: (12 seats * €120) * (27/31) = €1,254.84 (net)
- Scenario A — reverse-charge applies (Greystone provides valid EU VAT ID): issue net invoice €1,254.84, zero VAT, include wording: "Reverse charge applies under Article 196 EU VAT — customer liable for VAT."
- Scenario B — no VAT evidence provided by payment date: invoice gross with 19% VAT = €1,493.26. If later VAT ID provided, we will issue a credit for the VAT component after validation.

Recommended workflow (to minimize refunds and disputes):
1) Issue a proforma invoice for €1,254.84 (net) with memo "Held pending VAT ID validation — payment may be processed but will be adjusted if VAT is required." Link proforma to subscription so seats can be provisioned immediately once payment is received.
2) If customer pays and later we confirm VAT ID -> finalize invoice (net). If customer pays and we cannot validate VAT ID -> issue final invoice including VAT and apply the paid amount; if difference exists we either request top-up or issue a small credit, depending on which way it falls.
3) For bookkeeping: record proforma as pending receipt; once final invoice posted, mark payment accordingly.

Please ensure the proforma includes the bank details for EUR wire (IBAN) and a Stripe payment link. Suggested memo for proforma: "Prorated capacity charge for Jul 5–Jul 31 (12 seats) — held pending VAT evidence. Refer GREY-2026-07-05-INC."

If Neha confirms, finance will create the proforma and set the payment status to "awaiting VAT validation" in our billing console.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
